<div class="lead-academic">
I am a postdoctoral researcher at the Chair of Multilingual Computational Linguistics at the University of Passau, where I work on the **ProduSemy** project.
</div>

My research investigates **linguistic evolution**, with a particular focus on syntax and on how hierarchical structures change over time. Methodologically, I combine comparative typology, Bayesian phylogenetic inference, and computational modelling to study cross-linguistic patterns and their historical development.

I completed my PhD at the Institute for the Interdisciplinary Study of Language Evolution (ISLE), University of Zurich. My dissertation, *Syntactic Hierarchy in Linguistic Evolution: A Phylogenetic View of Clause-Linkage*, examined the emergence and diachronic behaviour of clause-linkage structures.
